The '''Belderone AT-AT factory''' was a major facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]]. Established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperials sent several supervisors to the planet to force the populace to work shifts at the factory. There were strict penalties for anyone that missed their shifts, and the [[Belderonian]]s made sure to always be on time. The [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] were produced for the purpose of invading a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base on the nearby planet of [[Kulthis]]. However, the Rebels learned of the plan, and a task force was sent to investigate. After discovering the factory, the Rebels [[Battle of Belderone (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] the facility, eventually destroying it with a commandeered AT-AT.
